protocol.policy: train on all active domains: one plain model on the pooled budgeted train partitions, selected on the pooled budgeted validation, and evaluated on each active domain's budgeted test partition separately

fold_membership.train: union of every active domain's budgeted train partition (3 x 40)
fold_membership.val: union of every active domain's budgeted val partition (3 x 10)
fold_membership.test: each active domain's budgeted test partition (50), scored separately

protocol.source_test_rationale: Every sample keeps one project-wide role: a domain's budgeted test partition is only ever tested on, never trained or validated on, and it is the same 50 images the LODO arms score for that domain.
protocol.target_test_rationale: Each domain is capped to the common 50-image budget and reported separately; the pooled score is renamed test_pooled and never quoted.
protocol.inactive_domains_note: RIM-ONE-DL is dropped from Step 4 for now. It stays under 'domains' so the locked parent and budgeted manifests, which cover all four domains, still revalidate; it never enters a fold as source or held-out.
protocol.pairing_rationale: Both train-on-all arms draw membership from the same budgeted manifest and share the backbone, active domains, budget, seeds, augmentation, optimiser and schedule; for each domain the 50 test images are identical and the conditioning is the only difference
protocol.regime_note: Nothing is held out: this is the SpFiLM draft's 'both' regime (train on every contrast, test on each with its known indicator). It measures whether conditioning helps when the domain is known, complementing LODO.

drishti_gs.note: provider_partition locks the 51-image provider test set and splits the 50-image provider training partition into 40 train / 10 val; test_fraction does not apply.

rim_one_dl.note: load_rim_one_dl_split_manifest is authoritative; the committed 70/10/20 manifest fixes membership and no fraction or seed in this file affects it.
